universe_selection: Same fixed 100 stocks as protocol_4h_lines.json; no use of retest profitability
higher_line_source: 4H bars derived from cached 1H candles using four_hour; use only bars whose final 1H source candle precedes the signal candle start
line_rule: Two confirmed 4H high pivots define resistance; two confirmed 4H low pivots define support. Project line one 4H bar ahead using only completed right-wing candles. At first bar whose high lies inside resistance ± width*ATR(14) and closes below resistance, short; mirrored low at support and close above for long. Deep break outside zone excluded. Adjacent candles with same contact produce only one signal.
ema_filter: none = line rejection alone; slope = EMA25 slope sign follows trade; turn = slope changed sign on signal bar. EMA25 touch is not required for retest entry.
exit: opposite EMA25 first-touch closes position on next open; opposite retest can reverse position
control: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch alone, same candles/costs
monthly_review: Show every complete continuous-account month, profitable and losing streaks, PnL by ex-post market regime, and trade counts. No fixed win-month ratio or trade-count threshold; all configurations remain in report for hypothesis generation.
candidate_policy: manual review only after full costs, lookahead and TradingView reconciliation; no automatic paper account
research_status: hypothesis chosen after owner inspected chart and earlier EMA25-line results; all historical results exploratory
cost_status: gross before commission, spread, slippage, dividends and short borrow; user requested no cost deduction for exploratory pattern search
screen_change_note: Cost-free and threshold-free monthly review requested after earlier results were inspected; exploratory, not a precommitted validation.
